about.title: About YourDrive
about.subtitle: Connecting drivers and passengers across Rwanda
about.missionText1: At YourDrive, we believe every journey is an opportunity to save, connect, and protect the planet.  Born from the idea of a "Common Route," we make intercity travel smarter, greener, and more human.
about.missionText2: is simple: share rides, save money, and cut carbon emissions — together.
about.driversText: Share your journey with others headed the same way. Offset your travel costs while reducing traffic congestion and your environmental footprint. YourDrive makes it easy to connect with verified passengers and manage your trips safely and efficiently.
about.passengersText: Find affordable rides to your destination without the hassle of driving. Browse available trips, connect with drivers, and enjoy a comfortable journey while sharing the cost. All drivers and vehicles are verified for your safety and peace of mind.
about.storyText1: Founded in 2025, YourDrive was born from a simple observation: too many cars on Canadian roads have empty seats, while many people struggle to find affordable transportation options between cities.
about.storyText2: Our founders, avid travelers themselves, recognized the potential to create a platform that would bring together drivers with extra seats and passengers looking for rides. The goal was to create a win-win situation: drivers could offset their costs, passengers could travel affordably, and everyone could reduce their environmental impact.
about.storyText3: Today, YourDrive continues to grow across Rwanda, connecting thousands of drivers and passengers every month and building a community of responsible travelers who share more than just a ride—they share a vision for a more connected, sustainable Rwanda.
about.joinText: Whether you're a driver with empty seats or a passenger looking for a ride, YourDrive makes it easy to connect and share the journey.

HelpCenter.title: Help Center
HelpCenter.subtitle: Find answers to all your questions about YourDrive
HelpCenter.supportDescription: Can't find what you're looking for? Our support team is here to help you 24/7.
HelpCenter.whatIsYourDriveDesc: YourDrive is a carpooling platform that connects drivers and passengers for affordable, flexible, and eco-friendly intercity travel.
HelpCenter.howItWorksDesc: Drivers post their rides. Passengers search and book seats based on their travel plans. Booking payment is made online, and both parties receive trip details once confirmed.
HelpCenter.cities: Which cities does YourDrive operate in?
HelpCenter.citiesDesc: YourDrive is available across Rwanda. Available rides depend on driver postings.
HelpCenter.safetyDesc: Yes. All users are verified via their phone numbers, and passengers can view ratings and reviews before confirming a ride.
HelpCenter.needApp: Do I need an app to use YourDrive?
HelpCenter.needAppDesc: You can access YourDrive through the mobile app or any web browser.
HelpCenter.bookRide: How do I book a ride?
HelpCenter.bookRideDesc: Enter your departure and destination, choose an available ride, book and pay online. You'll receive the driver's details once the booking is confirmed.
HelpCenter.messageDriver: Can I message the driver before booking?
HelpCenter.messageDriverDesc: No. Messaging is only available after your booking is confirmed.
HelpCenter.bookingFeesDesc: Yes, a small fixed fee — except for YourDrive Plus subscribers.
HelpCenter.cancelBooking: How do I cancel a booking?
HelpCenter.cancelBookingDesc: You can cancel through your account.
HelpCenter.choosePassenger: Can I choose who I travel with?
HelpCenter.choosePassengerDesc: Yes. You can view driver profiles, reviews, and ride details before booking.
HelpCenter.postRide: How do I post a ride?
HelpCenter.postRideDesc: Create an account, enter your departure, destination, date, and available seats, and then publish your ride.
HelpCenter.setPrice: Can I set my own price?
HelpCenter.setPriceDesc: Yes, within the minimum and maximum limits based on distance.
HelpCenter.whenPaidDesc:
- Cash / Interac: Paid directly by the passenger at the end of the trip.
- Online (credit/debit): Payment released after trip completion and confirmation by both parties.
- Complaints: Payment released after the issue is resolved.
- No confirmation: Payment released automatically after 24 hours if no complaint is filed.
HelpCenter.driverFees: Are there fees to post a ride?
HelpCenter.driverFeesDesc: Yes, for non-subscribed drivers. YourDrive Plus subscribers post rides with no fees.
HelpCenter.noShow: What if a passenger doesn't show up?
HelpCenter.paymentDesc: When you book a trip, you pay through the YourDrive platform using your preferred payment method (bank transfer, PayPal, etc.). The payment is held securely until the trip is completed. Once the trip is complete, the contribution is transferred to the driver minus our service fee. This ensures a secure transaction for both parties.
HelpCenter.rewards: How does the rewards program work?
HelpCenter.rewardsDesc: You earn 1 coupon per completed ride. Accumulate coupons to unlock free bookings or a free month of subscription.
HelpCenter.couponExpiryDesc: Yes. Unused coupons are valid for one year from the date they are issued, as long as your account remains active.
HelpCenter.howWorksDesc: YourDrive connects drivers with empty seats to passengers heading in the same direction. Drivers can post their trips, specifying route details, available seats, and trip preferences. Passengers can search for trips that match their desired route and book seats. Both parties contribute to the trip expenses, making travel more affordable and sustainable.
HelpCenter.redeSharing: Is YourDrive a ridesharing service like Uber or Lyft?
HelpCenter.redeSharingDesc: No, YourDrive is different. While rideshare services like Uber and Lyft connect passengers with drivers who operate as a taxi service, YourDrive connects passengers with drivers who are already making a journey and have empty seats. The driver is not making a profit but simply sharing the costs of a trip they would have taken anyway.
HelpCenter.create: How do I create an account?
HelpCenter.createDesc: Click on 'Sign Up' in the navigation menu. Fill out the registration form with your email address, create a password, and provide the required personal information. Verify your email address by clicking on the link sent to your inbox. Once verified, you can complete your profile with additional details.
HelpCenter.reset: How do I reset my password?
HelpCenter.resetDesc: On the login page, click on 'Forgot password?'. Enter the email address associated with your account, and we'll send you a link to reset your password. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.
HelpCenter.post: How do I post a trip as a driver?
HelpCenter.postDesc: Login to your account and navigate to the Driver section. Click on 'Post a Trip' and fill out the form with details about your journey, including starting point, destination, date, time, available seats, and any preferences (pets allowed, smoking, etc.). Review and confirm your trip details, and your trip will be posted for passengers to book.
HelpCenter.verify: How do I verify my car details?
HelpCenter.verifyDesc: To verify your car details, go to your Driver profile and select 'My Vehicles'. Click 'Add a Vehicle' and provide the required information including make, model, year, color, and license plate number. Upload clear photos of your vehicle registration and insurance. Our team will review and verify the information, typically within 24-48 hours.
HelpCenter.book: How do I book a trip as a passenger?
HelpCenter.bookDesc: Search for available trips by entering your starting point, destination, and travel date. Browse the search results and select a trip that suits your needs. Review the trip details including price, driver information, and trip preferences. Click 'Book Now' and complete the booking process. Once your booking is confirmed, you'll receive a confirmation email with trip details.
HelpCenter.cancel: What if my trip gets cancelled?
HelpCenter.cancelDesc: If a driver cancels before the scheduled departure and the passenger has paid for the trip online, the passenger will receive a full refund of the trip price. Please note that booking fees are non-refundable.
HelpCenter.coupons: What are YourDrive coupons and how do I earn them?
HelpCenter.couponsDesc:
YourDrive coupons are rewards you earn for using our platform. You receive 1 coupon for each completed trip.
• 5 coupons = 1 free booking or 1 free ride posting (either posting as a driver or booking as a passenger)
• 20 coupons = 1 free month subscription (available to both drivers and passengers, whether subscribers or not)
Coupons are automatically added to your account after each successful trip and expire 1 year after the date they are earned.

sections.title: Nature of the platform
sections.content: YourDrive is a digital platform that facilitates shared mobility services, including Point-to-Point carpooling, Door-to-Door ride requests, and DriveShare peer-to-peer vehicle rentals. YourDrive is not a transportation company, rental agency, or insurer.

sections.title: Eligibility and account registration
sections.content: You must be of legal age in your province or territory to create an account. You agree to provide accurate and up-to-date information and to keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for all activity conducted through your account.

sections.title: User roles
sections.content: Passengers may search, request, and book rides. Drivers may post rides and optionally offer Door-to-Door service, and are solely responsible for complying with driving, insurance, and safety laws. DriveShare Owners and Renters participate in peer-to-peer vehicle rentals under agreed conditions.

sections.title: Bookings, payments, and payouts
sections.content: Payments are processed by third-party providers such as Stripe. YourDrive does not store full payment card information. Users authorize payment processing, commissions, taxes, refunds, and payouts as described in applicable policies.

sections.title: Cancellations and Refunds

sections.title: User conduct
sections.content: Users must behave lawfully and respectfully. Prohibited conduct includes harassment, discrimination, misuse of personal data, and any activity that compromises safety or platform integrity.

sections.title: Content, ratings, and reviews
sections.content: Users may post content such as reviews, messages, and photos. By submitting content, you grant YourDrive a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use it for platform operations.

sections.title: Safety disclaimer
sections.content: YourDrive does not guarantee the conduct of users and does not perform criminal background checks unless expressly stated. Users are responsible for their own safety and interactions.

Policy.pageSubtitle: YourDrive Payment, Subscription, and Cancellation Policy
Policy.subscriptionPlansContent: Subscription and pay-per-use options for accessing the YourDrive platform
subscriptionPlansDetails: • Passengers: pay a booking fee per ride
• Drivers: pay a posting fee per ride
Policy.payPerUseContent: How passengers pay for rides and available payment methods
payPerUseDetails: • Online via YourDrive: Payment is authorized at booking and held until trip completion.
• Cash / Interac e-Transfer: If enabled by the driver, the passenger pays the driver directly at the end of the trip.
• Funds are released to the driver within 24 hours after trip completion and confirmation by both parties, provided no disputes are filed.
• If a dispute is filed, payout is held until the issue is resolved.
• YourDrive deducts service fees and applicable taxes before payout.
Policy.ridePaymentsContent: How and when drivers receive their earnings
ridePaymentsDetails: • Online-paid rides: Driver receives net amount (trip price minus service fees and taxes).
• Cash / Interac rides: Driver receives payment directly from the passenger.
Policy.driverPayoutsContent: Tax responsibilities for both YourDrive and drivers
driverPayoutsDetails: • YourDrive collects and remits GST/HST/QST on platform fees.
• Drivers are responsible for reporting any income earned on YourDrive.
Policy.taxesContent: Policies for ride cancellations, refunds, and related penalties
taxesDetails: (For non-subscribers; subscribers' booking fees are waived but seat price refunds follow the same rules.)
• Withdrawn or expired booking request: 100% refund of seat price (booking fee non-refundable).
• More than 24 hours before departure: Full refund of seat price (booking fee non-refundable).
• Less than 24 hours before departure: 50% refund of seat price (booking fee non-refundable); driver receives 50% of seat price. "Late cancellation" noted on passenger profile.
• No-show: No refund (see Passenger No-show Policy).
• If driver cancels: 100% refund of seat price and booking fee (see Driver Cancellation Policy).
• Passengers receive 100% refund of seat price and booking fee.
• A case is opened to assess justification and whether it counts towards the driver's allowance.
• Driver cancellation allowance: max 1 confirmed-passenger cancellation every 6 months.
• Repeated or unjustified cancellations may result in suspension.
Policy.passengerCancellationContent: Guidelines for missed rides by passengers or drivers
passengerCancellationDetails: • Passengers receive 100% refund of seat price and booking fee.
• Repeat offenses may lead to suspension.
• No refund of seat price or booking fee.
Policy.driverCancelBookingContent: How to report a missed ride or cancellation issue
driverCancelBookingDetails: • For no-shows or disputes, report via the YourDrive app within 24 hours.
• Support investigates and responds within 48 hours.
• Refunds are processed within 24 hours of resolution.
driverCancellationDetails: • All booking fees are non-refundable unless the driver cancels or is a no-show.
• All policies comply with Canadian consumer protection regulations.
• YourDrive reserves the right to update this policy with prior notice to users.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: This Safety & Trust Policy outlines the measures, responsibilities, and expectations designed to promote a safe, respectful, and reliable environment on the YourDrive platform. It applies to all users, including passengers, drivers, and DriveShare participants.

sections.title: Platform role disclaimer
sections.content: YourDrive is a digital platform that facilitates connections between users. YourDrive is not a transportation company, rental agency, employer, or insurer, and does not control user behavior or actions outside the platform.

sections.title: User Responsibilities
sections.content: All users are responsible for acting lawfully, respectfully, and in good faith. Users must comply with applicable laws, platform policies, and community standards at all times.

sections.title: Driver Safety Expectations
sections.content:
Drivers are responsible for: 
• Holding a valid driver's licence 
• Maintaining legally required insurance 
• Ensuring vehicle roadworthiness 
• Complying with traffic laws 
• Providing accurate ride information 
YourDrive does not perform criminal background checks unless explicitly stated.

sections.title: Passenger Safety Expectations
sections.content:
Passengers are responsible for: 
• Arriving on time at meeting points 
• Respecting driver instructions and preferences 
• Wearing seat belts where required 
• Behaving respectfully and lawfully during trips

sections.title: Ratings, Reviews, and Reliability
sections.content: YourDrive uses ratings and reviews to promote trust and accountability. Reviews may reflect punctuality, behavior, cancellations, or no-shows. Repeated negative patterns may affect visibility or account status.

sections.title: Cancellations and No-Shows
sections.content: Cancellations and no-shows are governed by the Cancellation Policy. Late cancellations, driver no-shows, or passenger no-shows may result in reviews, penalties, or account restrictions.

sections.title: Reporting Safety Concerns
sections.content: Users are encouraged to report safety concerns, misconduct, or policy violations through the platform. YourDrive may investigate reports and take appropriate action, including warnings, suspension, or account termination.

sections.title: Disputes and Investigations
sections.content: YourDrive may temporarily restrict accounts, hold payments, or request additional information while investigating disputes or safety-related reports.

sections.title: Emergency Situations
sections.content: In case of an emergency or immediate danger, users should contact local emergency services. YourDrive does not provide emergency response services.

sections.title: Abuse, Fraud, and Misuse
sections.content: Abusive behavior, fraud, manipulation of reviews, or misuse of the platform is strictly prohibited and may result in immediate account suspension or termination.

sections.title: Policy Updates
sections.content: YourDrive may update this Safety & Trust Policy to reflect operational, legal, or regulatory changes. Material updates will be communicated through the platform or by email.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For safety or trust-related concerns, contact: info@Your-Drive.ca

sections.title: Privacy Summary
sections.content: YourDrive complies with applicable Canadian and Quebec privacy laws, including the Consumer Privacy Protection Act (CPPA – Bill C27, when in force), the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA), and Quebec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (Law 25). Personal information is collected only for identified purposes, with consent, and retained only for as long as necessary.

sections.title: Data We Collect
sections.content: YourDrive collects personal data to operate the app safely and efficiently.

subsections.title: Identifiers
subsections.content: Names, email address, phone number, profile photo (optional).

subsections.title: Location
subsections.content: Approximate location (city/region) for Point-to-Point rides. Precise pickup and drop-off locations only when users explicitly request Door-to-Door services.

subsections.title: User content
subsections.content: Messages, trip details, reviews, ratings, support requests.

subsections.title: Financial information
subsections.content: Payment metadata (token IDs, timestamps). Full card numbers are never stored.

subsections.title: Diagnostics
subsections.content: Crash logs, performance data, device and app version.

subsections.title: Identifiers used for tracking
subsections.content: None. YourDrive does not track users across apps or websites owned by other companies.

subsections.title: App functionality
subsections.content: To create accounts, match drivers and passengers, process bookings, and enable Door-to-Door and Point-to-Point services.

subsections.title: Payments & Payouts
subsections.content: To process payments, refunds, disputes, and driver payouts via Stripe Connect.

subsections.title: Safety & Fraud prevention
subsections.content: To prevent fraud, detect abuse, verify users, and ensure platform safety.

subsections.title: Customer support
subsections.content: To respond to inquiries, disputes, and technical issues.

subsections.title: App performance
subsections.content: To analyze crashes, improve reliability, and enhance user experience.

subsections.title: Third-party service providers
subsections.content: Data is shared only with essential providers such as Stripe (payments), cloud hosting, and messaging services, under strict contractual obligations.

subsections.title: Other users
subsections.content: Limited data is shared with matched users only after booking confirmation.

subsections.title: Legal requirements
subsections.content: Information may be disclosed if required by law or to protect user safety.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.content: Financial records are retained for up to 7 years for tax and audit compliance. Other personal data is retained only as long as necessary, then anonymized or deleted.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: Users may request access, correction, or deletion of their personal data and withdraw certain consents, subject to legal requirements. Requests can be sent to: info@Your-Drive.ca

sections.title: Account Deletion
sections.content: Users may delete their account at any time from the app settings. Certain data may be retained where legally required (e.g. financial records).

sections.title: Contact Information
sections.content: Privacy Officer: info@Your-Drive.ca

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: This Payments & Refunds Policy explains how payments, refunds, payouts, disputes, and applicable taxes are handled on the YourDrive platform for Point-to-Point, Door-to-Door, and DriveShare services, in compliance with applicable Canadian and Québec laws.

sections.title: Accepted Payment Methods
sections.content: Only payments made through the YourDrive platform are accepted. All payments are processed exclusively in-app through third-party payment providers such as Stripe. Accepted methods may include credit cards, debit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, depending on availability.
sections.importantNote: Payments made outside the platform (including cash, Interac e-Transfer, or any direct payment between users) are strictly prohibited and not supported.

sections.title: Payment Authorization and Capture
sections.content: Payments are authorized at the time of booking using secure payment technology. Funds are held and captured only after the service is completed, unless otherwise specified (e.g., applicable cancellation fees).
sections.securityNote: YourDrive does not store full card numbers or CVV information.

sections.title: Payouts to Drivers and Owners
sections.content: Drivers and vehicle owners are independent service providers. Payouts are issued through Stripe Connect after completion of the service, subject to verification, compliance checks, and absence of disputes.
sections.note: Processing times may vary depending on the payment provider.

sections.title: Refunds – Passenger Cancellations
bullets: More than 24 hours before departure: full refund of the seat price
Less than 24 hours before departure: 50% refund of the seat price; remaining 50% paid to the driver
Less than 2 hours before departure: no refund
Withdrawn or expired booking request: full refund of the seat price

sections.title: Refunds – Driver Cancellations
sections.content: If the driver cancels a confirmed service, the passenger receives a 100% refund.
sections.consequence: Repeated or unjustified cancellations may result in penalties, account suspension, or termination.

sections.title: Disputes and Payment Holds
sections.content: Disputes must be reported within 2 hours of service completion.
sections.note: When a dispute is opened, payment capture or payout may be temporarily held while YourDrive reviews the matter and requests supporting evidence.

sections.title: Taxes
sections.content: YourDrive collects and remits applicable Canadian and Québec sales taxes only on its service fees and commissions, where required by law.
sections.responsibility: Drivers and owners are solely responsible for declaring and remitting taxes on their earnings.

sections.title: Non-Refundable Fees
sections.content: Booking fees are non-refundable except where the driver cancels or is a verified no-show.
sections.note: Promotional credits and discounts have no cash value.

sections.title: Security and Compliance
sections.content: All transactions are encrypted and processed through payment infrastructure compliant with PCI DSS standards.
sections.compliance: YourDrive complies with applicable Canadian privacy laws, including PIPEDA and Québec's Law 25, with respect to financial and personal data.

sections.title: Policy Updates
sections.content: YourDrive may update this policy to reflect legal, regulatory, or operational changes.
sections.communication: Material updates will be communicated through the platform or by email.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For questions regarding payments or refunds, contact: info@Your-Drive.ca

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: This Account & Data Deletion Policy explains how users may request deletion of their YourDrive account and personal data, and how such requests are handled in accordance with applicable Canadian privacy laws, including PIPEDA and Québec's Law 25.

sections.title: User rights
sections.content: Users have the right to access, correct, withdraw consent for, and request deletion of their personal information, subject to legal and contractual retention requirements.

sections.title: Account deletion requests
sections.content: Users may request account deletion through the platform settings or by contacting YourDrive Support. Identity verification may be required before processing the request.

sections.title: Data deletion scope
sections.content: Upon account deletion, YourDrive will delete or anonymize personal data that is no longer required for legal, regulatory, security, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, or accounting purposes.

sections.title: Data Retention Exceptions
sections.content:
Certain data may be retained for limited periods where required by law or legitimate business purposes, including:
• Transaction and payment records
• Tax and accounting records
• Dispute, fraud, or safety investigations
• Compliance with court orders or legal obligations

sections.title: Effect of account deletion
sections.content:
Once an account is deleted:
• The user will no longer be able to access the platform
• Active bookings or services will be cancelled
• Remaining promotional credits will be forfeited
• Reviews and ratings may be retained in anonymized form

sections.title: Processing time
sections.content: Deletion requests are processed within a reasonable timeframe, generally within 30 days, unless extended retention is required by law.

sections.title: Third-Party Service Providers
sections.content: Some data may be processed or retained by third-party service providers (e.g., payment processors, cloud hosting) in accordance with their own legal obligations and retention policies.

sections.title: Refusal or limitation of deletion
sections.content: YourDrive may refuse or limit a deletion request where permitted by law, including where deletion would compromise legal compliance, security, fraud prevention, or the rights of other users.

sections.title: Policy updates
sections.content: YourDrive may update this policy to reflect legal or regulatory changes. Material updates will be communicated through the platform or by email.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For account or data deletion requests, contact: info@Your-Drive.ca

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: This DriveShare Policy governs the peer-to-peer vehicle rental feature offered on the YourDrive platform ('DriveShare'). It defines the rights, responsibilities, and limitations applicable to vehicle owners and renters, in compliance with Québec and Canadian laws.

sections.title: Platform role disclaimer
sections.content: YourDrive is a digital platform facilitating connections between vehicle owners and renters. YourDrive is not a vehicle rental company, broker, insurer, or transportation provider, and does not own, maintain, inspect, or insure vehicles listed on the platform.

sections.title: Eligibility and account requirements
sections.content: Users must have an active YourDrive account and meet all legal eligibility requirements to participate in DriveShare. Vehicle owners and renters are responsible for ensuring they comply with applicable licensing, age, and insurance laws.

sections.title: Vehicle owner responsibilities
sections.content:
Vehicle owners are solely responsible for:
• Providing accurate vehicle information and availability
• Ensuring the vehicle is legally registered, insured, and roadworthy
• Maintaining the vehicle in safe operating condition
• Disclosing material defects or restrictions
• Complying with all applicable laws

sections.title: Renter responsibilities
sections.content:
Renters are solely responsible for:
• Holding a valid driver's licence for the class of vehicle rented
• Using the vehicle lawfully and responsibly
• Complying with traffic, parking, and usage laws
• Returning the vehicle on time and in agreed condition
• Reporting incidents, damage, or issues promptly

sections.title: Insurance and Liability
sections.content: Insurance coverage, if any, is the responsibility of the vehicle owner and/or renter. YourDrive does not provide insurance coverage and makes no representation regarding the adequacy of any insurance policy. Users are encouraged to verify coverage with their insurers prior to using DriveShare.

sections.title: Payments and Fees
sections.content: All DriveShare payments must be made exclusively through the YourDrive platform using authorized payment providers. Off-platform payments are strictly prohibited. Fees, commissions, and applicable taxes are disclosed prior to confirmation.

sections.title: Cancellations and Refunds
sections.content: DriveShare cancellations and refunds are governed by the applicable DriveShare cancellation rules displayed at booking and YourDrive's general Payments & Refunds Policy, where applicable.

sections.title: Damage, Loss, and Disputes
sections.content: Any damage, loss, theft, or dispute must be reported promptly through the platform. YourDrive may assist with documentation and communication but does not adjudicate liability or guarantee resolution.

sections.title: Prohibited uses
sections.content: DriveShare vehicles must not be used for illegal activities, sub-renting, racing, commercial transport, or any use not agreed upon by the parties.

sections.title: Safety and Conduct
sections.content: All DriveShare participants must comply with YourDrive's Safety & Trust Policy and Community Guidelines. Unsafe or abusive behavior may result in suspension or account termination.

sections.title: Policy updates
sections.content: YourDrive may update this DriveShare Policy to reflect operational, legal, or regulatory changes. Material updates will be communicated through the platform or by email.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For DriveShare-related questions, contact: support@Your-Drive.ca

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: This Door-to-Door Policy defines the rules, responsibilities, and limitations applicable to Door-to-Door ride requests on the YourDrive platform. It aims to ensure safety, clarity, and fairness for both passengers and drivers.

sections.title: Definition of Door-to-Door Service
sections.content: Door-to-Door is an optional service allowing passengers to request pickup and/or drop-off at a specific address rather than a general meeting point. Acceptance of Door-to-Door requests is at the driver's discretion.

sections.title: Platform role disclaimer
sections.content: YourDrive facilitates Door-to-Door requests but does not guarantee pickup or drop-off at exact addresses. YourDrive is not a transportation provider and does not control routing or driving decisions.

sections.title: Passenger responsibilities
sections.content:
Passengers requesting Door-to-Door service must:
• Provide accurate and safe pickup/drop-off addresses
• Ensure locations are legally accessible and safe to stop
• Be ready at the scheduled time
• Communicate promptly with the driver in case of delays

sections.title: Driver responsibilities
sections.content:
Drivers offering Door-to-Door service must:
• Confirm feasibility before accepting the request
• Follow traffic and parking laws
• Prioritize safety over convenience
• Decline requests that are unsafe or impractical

sections.title: Pickup and drop-off limitations
sections.content: Drivers are not required to stop in restricted zones, private property, unsafe locations, or areas prohibited by law. Alternative nearby locations may be proposed through the platform or direct communication.

sections.title: Waiting time and No-Show
sections.content: Door-to-Door requests are subject to the same waiting time and no-show rules as standard rides. Failure to appear within the allowed time may result in no-show penalties under the Cancellation Policy.

sections.title: Additional fees and pricing
sections.content: Door-to-Door pricing may reflect additional distance, time, or detours compared to Point-to-Point rides. Any applicable fees are displayed prior to booking and processed through the platform only.

sections.title: Cancellations and refunds
sections.content: Door-to-Door rides are subject to YourDrive's Cancellation Policy. Late cancellations, no-shows, or driver cancellations are handled according to that policy.

sections.title: Safety and Conduct
sections.content: All users must comply with the Safety & Trust Policy and Community Guidelines. Unsafe behavior, harassment, or unlawful requests may result in refusal of service or account action.

sections.title: Disputes and reporting
sections.content: Issues related to Door-to-Door service may be reported through the platform. YourDrive may review reports and take appropriate action consistent with its policies.

sections.title: Policy updates
sections.content: YourDrive may update this policy to reflect operational, legal, or regulatory changes. Material updates will be communicated through the platform or by email.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For questions regarding Door-to-Door service, contact: info@Your-Drive.ca

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: This Cancellation Policy sets out the rules governing cancellations, refunds, late cancellations, and no-shows on the YourDrive platform. It applies to Point-to-Point and Door-to-Door ride bookings and is governed by the laws of Québec and Rwanda.

sections.title: Scope and Exclusions
sections.content: This policy applies to all confirmed ride bookings made through the YourDrive platform. It does not apply to DriveShare peer-to-peer vehicle rentals, which are governed by a separate DriveShare Policy.

sections.title: Passenger-Initiated Cancellations
sections.content:
Refund eligibility for passenger-initiated cancellations depends on the time remaining before the scheduled departure.
More than 24 hours before departure:
• Full refund of the seat price.
Less than 24 hours but more than 2 hours before departure:
• 50% refund of the seat price.
• Remaining 50% paid to the driver as compensation.
• A 'Late cancellation' review may be added to the passenger's profile.
Less than 2 hours before departure:
• No refund.
• A late cancellation may be recorded on the passenger's profile.

sections.title: Withdrawn or Expired Booking Requests
sections.content: If a booking request is withdrawn by the passenger or expires without being accepted by a driver, a full refund of the seat price is issued.

sections.title: Driver-Initiated Cancellations
sections.content:
If a driver cancels a confirmed ride:
• Passengers receive a 100% refund.
• A cancellation review is added to the driver's profile.
• A case is opened to assess justification and whether the cancellation counts toward the driver's cancellation allowance.
Repeated or unjustified cancellations may result in reduced visibility, suspension, or account termination.

sections.title: No-Show Policy
sections.content:
A no-show occurs when a user fails to appear at the agreed meeting point within the allowed waiting time without cancelling through the platform.
Driver No-Show:
If the driver does not show up for a confirmed ride:
• Passengers receive a 100% refund.
• A 'No-show' review is added to the driver's profile.
• Repeated offenses may result in account suspension.
Passenger No-Show:
If the passenger fails to show up:
• No refund is issued.
• The driver may record a 'No-show' review on the passenger's profile.

sections.title: Reporting a Driver No-Show
sections.content: Passengers may report a driver no-show through the platform. If the no-show is confirmed, a 100% refund is issued. YourDrive may contact the driver to verify the situation.

sections.title: Abuse and Reliability
sections.content: Cancelling confirmed rides negatively affects platform reliability. YourDrive reserves the right to investigate repeated cancellations or no-shows and to apply corrective measures to protect the community.

sections.title: Refund Processing
sections.content: Refunds are processed through the original payment method via the YourDrive platform and its payment provider. Processing times may vary depending on financial institutions.

sections.title: Policy Updates
sections.content: YourDrive may update this policy to reflect operational, legal, or regulatory changes. Material updates will be communicated through the platform or by email.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For questions related to cancellations or refunds, contact: info@Your-Drive.ca

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: These Community Guidelines define expected behavior on the YourDrive platform. They promote a respectful, safe, and reliable community and support moderation, trust, and app store compliance.

sections.title: Be respectful
sections.content: Treat all users with respect. Harassment, threats, hate speech, discrimination, or abusive language are strictly prohibited.

sections.title: Be honest and transparent
sections.content: Provide accurate information in your profile, ride postings, messages, and reviews. Misrepresentation, impersonation, or misleading content is not allowed.

sections.title: Safety first
sections.content: Follow applicable laws and safety rules. Drivers must comply with traffic laws and insurance requirements. Passengers must follow reasonable safety instructions during trips.

sections.title: Appropriate communication
sections.content: Use the platform's messaging tools appropriately. Spam, solicitation, harassment, or sharing inappropriate content is prohibited.

sections.title: Reviews and ratings
sections.content: Reviews must be fair, factual, and based on actual experiences. Manipulating reviews, retaliation, or false reporting is prohibited.

sections.title: Cancellations and reliability
sections.content: Repeated late cancellations, no-shows, or unreliable behavior harm the community and may result in reduced visibility, restrictions, or account suspension.

sections.title: Prohibited conduct
sections.content: Users must not engage in illegal activities, fraud, off-platform payment requests, or attempts to bypass YourDrive's systems or policies.

sections.title: Enforcement
sections.content: Violations of these Guidelines may result in warnings, content removal, temporary restrictions, suspension, or permanent account termination.

sections.title: Reporting issues
sections.content: Users are encouraged to report violations or concerns. YourDrive reviews reports and takes appropriate action when necessary.

sections.title: Updates
sections.content: YourDrive may update these Community Guidelines as needed. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the updated guidelines.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For questions or reports, contact: info@Your-Drive.ca
